# Engineering Manager (M/F/D)

At Tradepoint, we're looking for an experienced Engineering Manager to help scale our engineering organization and support the delivery of reliable, scalable, and high-quality software solutions across the entire client journey.

As an Engineering Manager, you will lead one or more cross-functional engineering squads and play a key role in building strong teams, improving engineering practices, and ensuring successful delivery of business-critical applications. You will combine people leadership with delivery ownership, helping engineers grow while aligning engineering execution with business objectives.

## What you'll do

As our Engineering Manager, you will create an environment where teams can thrive, deliver impactful software, and continuously improve their ways of working.

Your responsibilities include:

- Lead, coach, and develop engineering teams through feedback, performance management, and career development.
- Foster a culture of ownership, collaboration, continuous improvement, and technical excellence.
- Ensure predictable and high-quality delivery of software projects and initiatives.
- Collaborate closely with Product Managers, Tech Leads, Designers, and other stakeholders to align priorities and execution.
- Balance delivery objectives with technical sustainability and team capacity.
- Drive improvements in engineering practices, testing, deployment processes, and operational reliability.
- Support engineers in their professional growth and help build engaged, high-performing teams.
- Promote the responsible use of AI-assisted tools to improve software delivery and team productivity.
- Drive alignment and collaboration across squads and contribute to engineering-wide improvements.
- Help shape products and services that improve onboarding, investing, trading, compliance, and client experience across Europe.

## Who you are

You are an experienced engineering leader who enjoys building strong teams and creating an environment where people and technology can excel.

- You have 5+ years of experience in software engineering, including experience in an Engineering Manager, Team Lead, or similar leadership role.
- You have a strong understanding of modern software development practices and agile methodologies.
- You have experience delivering complex software products in a collaborative environment.
- You have proven experience leading, coaching, and developing engineering teams.
- You possess excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
- You are fluent in English
- You are experienced in working with cross-functional and distributed teams.
- You have strong organizational, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.

Nice to have

- Experience with cloud-native architectures, DevOps practices, and modern engineering tooling.
- Experience within financial services, fintech, trading platforms, or other highly regulated environments.
- Professionally fluent in Dutch or German, depending on the office location.
- Experience scaling engineering teams in an international organization.

## What we offer
- Flexible working hours in one of our European offices, preferably Berlin or Antwerp.
- An attractive compensation package and participation in our bonus system.
- A friendly and collaborative environment where people support each other and celebrate success together.
- The freedom to choose the tools and equipment you need to do your best work.
- A yearly personal training budget to support your professional and personal development.
- Free hot and cold drinks, fruit, and regular team activities.
- A comprehensive benefits package, including pension plan, insurance, meal vouchers, and additional holidays (depending on location).
- Company-wide events, including summer and Christmas celebrations.
- A unique opportunity to learn more about financial markets and trading technology.
